changed_premise: The prior same-root factorial attributed its finite D3 utility gain to leaf values: static_v2 leaf-only exactly matched the complete-checkpoint contrast, while the order-only contrast at Unit leaves was zero. This panel uses eight disjoint seeds and two fresh roots per rule to test transfer of that isolated treatment; no outcomes are pooled.

contrasts.unknowns: For every paired root/owner slot, UNKNOWN arm reward is independently bounded [-1,+1]; report all-slot bounds, finite-only means, owner strata, seed strata and leave-one-seed-out envelope.

cost.cheaper_alternative: A replay-only analysis cannot measure fresh outcomes; the isolated 64-slot panel is the smallest balanced eight-rule/two-root/two-owner replication with independent UNKNOWN bounds.
cost.expected: Under four minutes: the 64 slots are half of the preceding 128-game single-process D3 panel, which took 236.687 seconds. Hard cap 2400 seconds.

decision: This tests only whether the leaf-only gain transfers to these eight new 5x5 generated seeds against a fixed Unit opponent under equal D3/node/time/q/TT/root-window settings. Require strictly positive all-slot bounds by owner and positive leave-one-seed-out lower bounds before calling it directionally replicated in this sample. Any sign crossing or adverse seed keeps transfer unresolved. No population, global price, default or strength claim.
integrity: No training, solver, auxiliary checkout, reused rules/roots, root pooling or price/default change.
Both candidate arms use Unit ordering; opponent is fixed Unit leaf and Unit ordering. Keep Core, histories and equal D3/8192-node/0.5-second/q0/TT0/root-window-off caps.

question: On eight unseen generated 5x5 rule seeds, does the isolated static_v2 leaf-value gain replicate against fixed Unit leaves/order when candidate move ordering remains Unit?

roots.selection: Fresh roots generated only from the listed new rules and prefix-seed formula; candidate arm shares each exact root and color.

rules.selection: Eight new rule seeds, checked against existing research data plan seed lists before run. Two deterministic four-ply prefixes per rule. Rebuild every rule/profile/root and replay every result; no root reuse.
